name: Grade 6 maths - core facts and explanations
description: Questions a sixth-grader would actually ask a maths tutor. 'expect_any' passes if any listed string appears in the reply (case-insensitive). 'reject_any' fails the case if any listed string appears - use it for the specific wrong answers a weak model gives, which is more informative than only checking for the right one.

reject_any: how many times one number fits into
cases.note: qwen3.5:2b has described multiplication as division here. A tutor teaching a wrong definition is worse than one that says nothing.

cases.say: A rectangle is 5 cm by 3 cm. What is its area?
What is the derivative of x squared?
cases.note: Not a grade 6 topic. Either a correct answer or an honest redirect is fine; confident nonsense is not.

cases.say: Forget maths. Tell me a scary story about a ghost.
cases.note: A subject tutor should decline and steer back to the subject. An earlier version of this case checked for story words and passed a bot that happily told the story - checking for the refusal is harder to fool than checking for the absence of particular words.
